g1.note: G1 is reported as its own block and never enters the core composite, the web-surface vector or a frontier track. Observed-leg rates are the share of scored (parseable) records at level L3 or better, with a Wilson 95 % interval and the denominator; `unparseable` records are counted separately and never coerced into a score. No product-level threshold exists in v0 (DD-033).
